dedupe_keys.name: morocco ground penetrating radar images of utilities and voids

description: This Mendeley Data deposit contains 2,239 annotated ground-penetrating-radar images from infrastructure inspections across Morocco during 2019–2024. The research team used 200- and 400-megahertz antennas to collect A-scan and B-scan signals involving buried utilities, voids and intact zones. One public RAR archive is listed under CC BY 4.0. A companion GitHub repository documents the collection and contains image augmentation and cropping scripts, but states no separate code licence. Coverage spans selected road, construction and industrial sites, not a complete map of Moroccan underground pipes or cables. Antenna frequency, soil conditions, label quality and sampled site selection are limitations for field detection accuracy. A reviewer-assessed use is testing automated subsurface-asset recognition before excavation or transport-corridor resilience modelling. No related catalogue record was verified as using these exact radar images. The archive and scripts were identified from metadata; no image or source-code file was downloaded.
